Plan the details before your next move.

Prepare your inventory, transport options, pickup details and inquiry in one place. Work through the steps that fit your move, then confirm arrangements with the team.

Your inquiry checklist ↓
Define your route and date windowList vehicles and household goods separatelyDescribe access at both locationsDiscuss transport and storage optionsReview the quote before confirmingKeep records at pickup and delivery

  1. Define your route and date window

    Gather both five-digit ZIP codes, your available pickup window and expected move-in date. Pickup and delivery dates need confirmation from the team and carrier. Historical transit times are not promises.

    Shipping your car, from planning to handover →An interstate move starts with a good inventory →

  2. List vehicles and household goods separately

    For a vehicle, note its year, make, model, running condition, dimensions and modifications. For household goods, list box counts and sizes, furniture photos, and fragile, oversized or disassembly needs. Vehicles and furniture may travel separately.

    Shipping your car, from planning to handover →An interstate move starts with a good inventory →Luggage in your car: what to confirm first →

  3. Describe access at both locations

    Include floors, stairs, elevator reservations, building access, loading zones, parking restrictions and permitted moving hours. Ask whether extra carrying, disassembly or packing is available and how it is charged.

    An interstate move starts with a good inventory →Understanding a moving or auto transport quote →

  4. Discuss transport and storage options

    Ask whether open or enclosed vehicle transport fits your needs. If you need storage before moving in, describe the goods, estimated duration and retrieval needs; confirm location, access, care and fees.

    Open or enclosed: choosing how your car travels →Storage between one home and the next →

  5. Review the quote before confirming

    Request written scope, inclusions and exclusions, additional fees, payment stages, quote validity, cancellation terms, insurance and issue-handling procedures. An inquiry summary is preparation, not a booking or a binding quote.

    Understanding a moving or auto transport quote →Before you move: ship your car or sell it? →

  6. Keep records at pickup and delivery

    Take photos, retain a condition or inventory list, and confirm contacts and handover procedures. Compare the delivered items with your records. Report discrepancies promptly to the driver and team, preserve evidence and follow your contract.

    Shipping your car, from planning to handover →An interstate move starts with a good inventory →Graduating and moving for a new job: a checklist →

Your inquiry checklist

  • Both ZIP codes and available date window
  • Vehicle details or an inventory with photos
  • Floors, elevators, parking and access at both ends
  • Packing, loading, disassembly or storage needs
  • Contact name, email and special requirements

Send your needs and keep a copy

Review your summary, then open Gmail with a draft addressed to help@carshipping168.com. Add any inventory or vehicle photos as attachments in Gmail, check the details and press Send yourself. You can also download a text copy or contact the team by phone, LINE or WeChat. The website does not send email automatically or confirm a booking.

Looking for past experiences?

Guides explain preparation; the original library preserves articles from both sites. Historical prices, addresses, timing and individual experiences may be outdated. Confirm current terms with the team. Original articles are not fully translated or independently fact-checked.
